description: Search through past user conversations to find relevant context and information
name: mcp__claude_ai__conversation_search

max_results.description: The number of results to return, between 1-10

query.description: A short search query describing what to find

within_conversation_id.description: Optional chat UUID; restricts the search to that one chat. Use it to find a spot inside a chat you already have (a recent_chats entry, a pasted link, a summary hit), then read_conversation at the returned page_token.
